mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (student_id, activity_id, content, created_at, is_read) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{activityId}, #{content}, #{createdAt}, #{isRead})
mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id, activity_id, content, created_at, is_read FROM message WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY is_read ASC, created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET is_read = 1 WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND is_read = 0
